mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; trazodone inhibits serotonin reuptake while phenelzine inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating risk for serotonin syndrome.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together; if switching from one to the other, allow adequate washout period (at least 14 days for phenelzine discontinuation before trazodone, or 1 week for trazodone before phenelzine).
